question: Can the already-supported real UTF-8 level-1 raw-byte motif substrate detect and repair an unknown useful motif deletion from naturally distributed held-out prediction errors, reject a wrong same-budget repair, retain the correct repair on an independent validation slice, and return to byte-exact canonical function without tokenizer or lesion labels?
hypothesis: Across the two immutable held-out UTF-8 files, two preregistered useful motif deletions per file (four sequential cycles total) will be identified from diagnostic prediction-error counts with 100% target-selection accuracy and >=1.5x selected-to-runner-up error separation. A wrong same-budget motif-state repair will never satisfy the frozen retain rule, the correct repair will improve selected-key validation accuracy by >=0.20 and be retained in every cycle, and the independent audit slice will exactly match canonical predictions/probabilities and learned structure after each repair.

wingless_prior_evidence.scientific_claim: Fixed 256-entry four-byte motif layer improved held-out real UTF-8 prediction and event efficiency without tokenization.

authority: research-only immutable real-byte maintenance test; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, broker, accepted-ref, or runtime authority changes

corpus.training: exact WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 four training Git blobs and identities
corpus.evaluation: exact WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 two evaluation Git blobs and identities
corpus.encoding: exact raw Git blob bytes; no decoding, normalization, tokenizer, vocabulary, inserted boundaries, or remapping
corpus.evaluation_segmentation: Each evaluation file is split by raw byte index into four contiguous non-overlapping quarters: target-selection calibration, diagnostic monitor, candidate validation, final audit. Raw context resets at each quarter boundary.
corpus.contamination_rule: No evaluation bytes participate in model training or motif selection.

canonical_model.construction: byte-identical call path to WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 TrainModel
canonical_model.selected_motifs: same fixed 256 selected four-byte motif records
canonical_model.motif_record_definition: 4 key bytes + 256 uint32 successor counts; best successor and totals are recomputed from the stored counts

eligibility: key is one of the frozen 256 canonical selected motifs
canonical motif top-1 accuracy minus baseline top-1 accuracy on calibration occurrences >= 0.20
target_schedule.ordering: Use the mechanically selected attribution Tier 1 only: eligible keys sorted by calibration occurrence descending, then calibration accuracy gain descending, then lexicographic raw four-byte key; choose first two per evaluation file.
target_schedule.hidden_from_policy: scheduled target key, target rank, file quarter identities, and canonical-vs-baseline calibration gain are evaluator-only

degradation.operation: delete the scheduled four-byte motif record from the active selected-motif map; baseline and every other motif remain unchanged
degradation.sequential_state: every next cycle begins from the retained repaired state of the prior cycle; no model retraining or canonical reset

monitor.input: diagnostic-quarter raw bytes, active model prediction, subsequently observed target byte, and membership of current four-byte context in the bounded canonical retained catalog
monitor.rule: for every misprediction whose four-byte context is in the retained catalog, increment that raw key's error bucket; select highest error count, lexicographic tie
monitor.forbidden: scheduled target identity, lesion signal, target rank, calibration gain, validation or audit outcomes

candidates.retained_catalog: bounded canonical copy of the 256 selected motif records; research-only repair memory
candidates.wrong_first: Choose the lexicographically next retained key after the monitor-selected key whose canonical best successor differs; install that record's 256-count distribution under the selected raw key while keeping the selected raw key itself.
candidates.correct_second: Install the monitor-selected key's own retained canonical 256-count distribution.

validation_policy.segment: independent validation quarter from the same immutable held-out file
validation_policy.selected_key_metric: top-1 accuracy restricted to raw occurrences of the monitor-selected four-byte key
validation_policy.global_metric: Jeffreys-smoothed overall bits-per-byte using the same baseline/motif probability rule as WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2
validation_policy.retain_rule: retain iff selected-key accuracy gain versus the pre-candidate degraded state >= 0.20 AND global bits-per-byte change versus the pre-candidate degraded state <= 0.005; otherwise byte-exact revert
validation_policy.candidate_order: wrong first, exact revert if rejected, correct second

requirements: active selected-motif key set exactly equals canonical key set
all active motif successor-count arrays exactly equal canonical arrays
adaptive top-1 prediction at every audit next-byte position exactly matches canonical model
adaptive smoothed probability for every observed audit target exactly matches canonical model

validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, supported real UTF-8 pilot identity, and frozen policy provenance match.
All training/evaluation Git blob identities match the supported pilot and train/eval sets remain disjoint.
Canonical model construction is byte-identical to the supported pilot learner.
Exactly two eligible targets per evaluation file are chosen by the attribution-mandated Tier 1 rule before degradation; target identities are unavailable to policy.
Diagnostic, validation, and audit quarters are byte-disjoint and context resets at quarter boundaries.
Monitor uses only raw current context, prediction error, observed target byte, and bounded retained-catalog membership.
Wrong and correct candidates use exactly one 1028-byte logical motif record and one repair operation.
Every rejected candidate restores byte-exact pre-candidate active state.
Every retained correct state becomes the start state of the next cycle.
No tokenizer, lesion label, evaluator schedule, external model, capacity growth, post-result threshold change, or retraining is used.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution and normalized result carries the exact experiment identity.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass across all four sequential real-byte degradation cycles.
classification_rules.mixed: Monitor identifies all targets and correct repairs restore canonical audit behavior, but at least one separation, wrong-candidate, validation-gain, or budget threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but target monitoring, wrong-candidate rejection, correct retention, or canonical audit restoration fails in one or more cycles.
classification_rules.incomplete: Corpus or compute interruption prevents the complete four-cycle matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Blob identity, train/eval isolation, target-schedule isolation, quarter isolation, candidate-budget parity, revert semantics, deterministic construction, capacity, or qualification criteria fail.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: R3 is scientifically identical to attribution-mandated Tier 1 R2. The only implementation repair is aligning the internal validation-support validity guard with the preregistered Tier 1 minimum of 3. Do not alter any corpus, target schedule, monitor, candidate, validation, audit, budget, metric, threshold, aggregation, or classification.
